comments.overrides: Force PATCHED transitive deps without downgrading top-level packages. npm audit's own 'fixes' would downgrade Next 16 -> 9 and drizzle-kit -> 0.18, which is why `npm audit fix --force` breaks the app. These three are build/dev-time only. Revisit when Next/drizzle-kit bump them upstream.
comments.brace-expansion-note: NOT overridden on purpose: the only patched version (5.0.8) drops the callable `expand` export, which breaks the minimatch@3 that eslint 9's plugins pin ('expand is not a function'). The residual brace-expansion/minimatch advisories are dev-only (eslint) and never ship in the app or the build output; they clear when eslint-config-next releases a build on the newer eslint toolchain.
